title: Kissed Silky Portuguese Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Portuguese chicken stew with a rich and silky texture, made with charred chicken and a touch of butter, suitable for diabetic diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set it aside.
Add the butter to the pot and let it melt, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, white wine, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Use an immersion blender to puree the sauce until it is smooth and silky, or allow it to cool and puree it in a blender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
